coverage: Unreported and incapable workers skip tasks without consuming attempts or changing the model
A real reference Runtime executes an eligible later task while a MuJoCo task stays queued
Per-process reports govern claims even if a same-named registry row was overwritten
Partial telemetry remains usable; disabled telemetry source policies do not require unused probes
Pending protocol changes refresh task requirements, including raw SQL enqueue paths
Each generation has an atomic capability receipt; failed receipt writes roll back admission
Lease recovery preserves previous receipts and fences stale writers
Lease time starts after a real database advisory-lock wait
Read-only reasons reflect barriers, zero limits, offline/drained nodes, capacity and expired leases
Project-scoped cursors and receipt APIs reject foreign access; admin scheduling does not expose model content
Real browser queued-to-completed transition, actual native worker receipt and JSON download
Chinese and English narrow layouts inspected; missing dynamic labels fixed and added to source audit
limits: Capability matching does not prove numerical backend equivalence or provide host affinity
Direct database workers remain trusted deployment components, not anonymous public compute clients
Queue reasons are bounded observations, not position reservations or strict fairness
No OS resource isolation in this phase; no new MQ/database service or old data migration
Docker image verification belongs to the next deployment phase and is not claimed by these tests
